title: Formation of gp37 LTF needle trimers-LPS complex
author: Mohammad Z. Islam

steps_raw.instruction: Formation of gp37 LTF needle trimers-LPS complex
Labeling of purified protein with Diazirine
Take 100 µl to 1 ml of purified gp37 LTF needle trimers in phosphate buffer saline (PBS).
Dissolve NHS-ester diazirine crosslinking reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL) in DMSO to prepare a 10 mM stock solution immediately before use.

3. Add the diazirine crosslinker solution to the trimers at a final crosslinker concentration of 0.5-2 mM. If the protein concentration is >5 mg/ml, use a 10-fold molar excess of the crosslinker. For samples <5 mg/ml, use a 20- to 50-fold molar excess of the crosslinker.
4. Incubate the reaction on ice for 2 hr.
5. Stop the reaction by adding Quenching Buffer to a final concentration of 100 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0.
6. Incubate the reaction on ice for 15 min.

7. Remove excess un-reacted crosslinker reagent using Zeba Spin Desalting Columns (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL) or Slide-A-Lyzer Dialysis Cassettes (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL).

Take the diazirine-labeled gp37 LTF needle trimers (150 µg) and 500 µg of LPS (E. coli 0111:B4; Sigma-Aldrich, St Louis, MO) in a 200 µl reaction volume in PBS and incubate at 37°C for 1 hr. For controls, incubate the same amounts of diazirine-labeled gp37 without LPS and LPS without diazirine-labeled gp37 in the same buffer in separate tubes.
UV irradiate the reaction mixtures kept on an ice pack to prevent excessive heat generation for 15 min using Stratagene Stratalinker 2400.
Separate the crosslinked products by size-exclusion column chromatography (Superose 6 10/300 GL, GE Healthcare Bioscience).
Analyze the fractions by SDS-PAGE and stain the gel with Silver Stain (Pierce, Rockford, IL).
